name: unknown-benefactor-3d
description: 20-second 3D animated short: Blender (Cycles) frames assembled with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts UnknownBenefactor out/raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --browser-executable=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium && npm run finalize
scripts.finalize: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/raw.mp4 -vf scale=in_range=full:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_range tv -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -t 20 -movflags +faststart out/unknown-benefactor.mp4 && rm out/raw.mp4
